text: The Golden Drop stage is Crumble Dungeon (크럼블 던전): your whole collection vs the Holy Golden Drop (황금갓방울), scored on damage, ranked per server.
detail: One key per run. The top 40 by power deploy; the rest replace the dead. No formation, pets or manual control; up to a minute. No power penalty.

text: Top score: 379.3G at 15.58G total power (스미노프TFT, 2026-09-28); next 325.9G at 10.10G (전치, 2026-09-27).
detail: Then 244.7G at 6.62G (09-17), 221.4G at 9.23G (VART, 09-26), 219.5G at 7.26G (섬영, 09-15). All screenshot or video; text claims reach 350G.

text: Every top run is one engine: Milk captain at top ATK, the beam routed down a set ATK order, a packed formation Milk reaches early.
detail: 379G: Milk, Scorpion, Figure, Brightseeker, Macaron, Melon Soda. 325.9G and 221.4G: Milk, Brightseeker, Scorpion, Figure, Macaron, Cheesecake. ND러너: Milk, Macaron, Figure.

text: Open choice, the beam after Milk: the record recommends dealers first, Scorpion and Figure (or Brightseeker, Scorpion, Figure).
detail: Both top-two runs beam dealers first; ND러너's buffer-first setting (Macaron, Figure) tops out lower. Try it only if Macaron has high ATK runes.

text: Power sets the scale, not the ranking: the lineup rules are the build.
detail: At similar power, scores differ several-fold: 244.7G at 6.62G vs 113.3G at 6.79G; 325.9G at 10.10G vs 127.1G at 10.15G.
50-60G to 75.4G with less power shown; 3G to 6G copying ND러너's levels; EOG +42% from benching two strong cookies.

text: Leaving cookies out matters as much as bringing them: chargers, summoners and Projectile Speed recipients go to Lv.1. Never use Bari.
detail: The Exclusions page lists them with reasons; EOG measured +42% on one account from benching Oven Wanderer and Cool Mint.

text: Cheesecake changed sides on 2026-09-10: excluded while its buff erased Milk's stacks, kept (sixth in ATK) once the stronger stacked buff won.
detail: Lime followed the same path in the 379G lineup. Resolved: keep Cheesecake, sixth in ATK; drop it only on a pre-9/10 client.

text: Gear is an arena-style damage preset; a move-speed line helps Milk arrive.
detail: Skill Haste, Skill AMP, crit, damage reduction; no accuracy or focus. A move-speed preset took one account from 50-60G to 75.4G on less power.

text: Runs swing by tens of G, so records come from retries.
detail: 90-150G on one account, 150-188G for ND러너. Rewards pay the day's and the week's best, so spend every key.

text: Breaking the rules costs more than the swing.
detail: Records are best-of-many, but the lineup sets the level: Bari in kept one account barely past 100G.
